name: Windows kernel pool corruption via vulnerable third-party driver
topic: Windows kernel pool corruption via vulnerable third-party driver
description: Windows kernel pool corruption via vulnerable third-party driver -- a insane-tier privilege escalation challenge. Review the bundled artifacts, locate the encoded clue, decode it, and recover the flag. Flag format: pwn{...}
objectives: Inspect the challenge bundle for "Windows kernel pool corruption via vulnerable third-party driver"
Locate the encoded artifact (look in every shipped file)
Unwrap the encoding applied to the artifact
Recover the plaintext flag and submit it in pwn{...} format

hints.text: Start by inspecting every file in the bundle (hex dump, headers, magic bytes).
The artifact is wrapped in a non-text container -- use the right parser.
The artifact is layered: hex -> byte-reverse -> XOR with a 4-byte key. Recover the key with a known-plaintext crib.
